title: Attraction
description: Tourist attraction or point of interest with name, location, type, rating, and description. Used for travel guides, tourism platforms, and destination discovery applications.

name.description: Name of the tourist attraction or point of interest

city.description: City where the attraction is located

country.description: Country where the attraction is located

type.description: Type of attraction (e.g., Museum, Park, Monument, Beach, Landmark)

rating.description: Average visitor rating, typically on a scale of 1-5

description.description: Detailed description of the attraction and what visitors can expect
